prose: Axios sources, as relayed by Techmeme, say Howard Lutnick has delayed restrictions on companies suspected of diverting Nvidia chips to China despite another presidential approval on November 5. The item concerns a reported gap between approval and implementation. The source fetch failed, so the account cannot establish the full decision process or responses from the officials concerned.
highlights: Sources allege a delay in chip-diversion curbs
Feed dates the latest approval to November 5
basis: Techmeme headline and excerpt of Axios reporting; source fetch failed.
